parameterdescription.para: Module ID whose entry is required. Must be less than XASU_MAX_MODULES.

simplesect.para: Pointer to the XAsu_CryptoAlgInfo entry of the given module.

The module info region at RTCA 0xA8 is 180 bytes and hence holds the entries of module IDs 0 to 14 only. Entries of module IDs 15 and above are read from and written to the extension region at RTCA 0x1A4, as indexing the first region with those module IDs would land on the debug log buffer info at RTCA 0x15C.
